content:
Nate C: Quick UX check: preview is confusing about send order + suppressed channels. support asked why PagerDuty wasn't first.
Rina P: Our preview sorts by latest-edit. users expect either Configured Priority or Runtime Dispatch. we should pick and label it.
Omar S: Accessibility note: DOM order must match visual order. if CSS reorders, SRs get wrong output.
Luz M: Backend: runtime can insert fallbacks after failures, so dispatch may differ from configured priority. we can add a small "preview_snapshot" in API to avoid client-side heuristics.
Nate C: Proposal: default to "Dispatch (first -> last)" with a small explainer and a dropdown to switch to "Configured priority". show suppressed channels greyed out with reason.
Rina P: Copy for aria-live (polite): "This alert will notify PagerDuty, then Slack, then Email. Suppressed: Ops-email for 2 hours." short and explicit.
Omar S: Make suppressed rows include actor and relative time in sr-only text. use role=status for the summary.
Luz M: We'll add suppressed_until_relative and actor in the preview API. frontend flag-gated rollout.
flag-bot: Note: feature-flag will be required. rollout doc: https://go/redwood/ux/preview-ordering
Nate C: I'll mock compact and expanded previews and post images. tagging @Rina P for copy review. :thumbsup:
